datasets.source: Supplied privately by the authors to the study on request; not published. Queue dataset record lc1a3wrizj82i1e.
datasets.license_or_permission: No license. The authors granted the study permission to reproduce (queue record: permission_to_reproduce 'yes') and supplied the files. Gate ksl-data-cloud-use records the confirmation that this covers the study's Modal workspace.
datasets.preprocessing: PIL convert('L'), resize((320, 120)), float32, divide by 255, as in Read_data.ipynb.
datasets.split_rule: Random and unstratified: sklearn train_test_split(test_size=0.2) then train_test_split(test_size=0.5) on the remainder, both with the run's seed. Each run's metrics.json lists its test files.

metric_definitions.name: Total parameters
metric_definitions.implementation: Keras Model.count_params() on the built model
metric_definitions.unit_or_scale: millions of parameters, as printed in Table 1
metric_definitions.paper_definition: Table 1 column 'Total params (M)'; the paper does not say how it was counted.

metric_definitions.name: Accuracy
metric_definitions.implementation: Keras 'accuracy' metric from Model.evaluate on the test split: correct predictions / test images
metric_definitions.aggregation: one run, all test images, final epoch
metric_definitions.paper_definition: Eq. (1): (TP + TN) / (TP + TN + FP + FN). Fig. 9 confirms the reported LeNet value is correct / total: 208 / 210 = 0.990.

metric_definitions.name: Loss
metric_definitions.implementation: Keras categorical_crossentropy from Model.evaluate on the test split
metric_definitions.aggregation: mean over all test images, final epoch
metric_definitions.paper_definition: Sec. 5.2: 'loss function, categorical cross entropy'; models 'were tested on a test sample'.

metric_definitions.name: Penalty
metric_definitions.implementation: Not implemented: the 42x42 penalty matrix is not published
metric_definitions.aggregation: Eq. (2): S = -(1/N) * sum over predictions of A[true, predicted]
metric_definitions.unit_or_scale: matrix entries range from 0 to 4 in Fig. 4
metric_definitions.paper_definition: Eq. (2) and Fig. 4 ('Example of penalty matrix values', 12 of 42 classes). Eq. (2) gives values at or below zero; Table 1 reports 3.017 to 3.130.

terminal.detail: The archive upload hung: the client sat idle with open connections and transferred nothing. It was found on 2026-11-23 and killed. Nothing had reached the Volume (the dataset path did not exist) and no app had started.

runs.purpose: Exercise the real path cheaply: load real images, build all four models and confirm their parameter counts, train 1 epoch on 10 images per class, save and reload weights, evaluate the test split. Measures time and GPU memory.

terminal.detail: LeNet, AlexNet and ResNet50 completed 1 epoch, the weight save/reload round trip and test evaluation. EfficientNetB7 raised ResourceExhaustedError: the 15 GB T4 ran out of memory at batch size 64.

runs.observed: Parameter counts: lenet 1,071,162; alexnet 35,498,090; resnet50 23,667,498, equal to Table 1's 1.07, 35.5 and 23.7 M. Reloaded weights reproduced the test metrics exactly for all three. Fit time for 1 epoch on 336 images: 6.1 s, 3.3 s, 19.9 s. Peak GPU memory: 1.01, 2.37, 7.79 GB. Hypothesis for the retry: a GPU with more memory runs EfficientNetB7 at the same batch size, so the protocol stays unchanged.

runs.purpose: Repeat the preflight for EfficientNetB7 on a 40 GB A100 at the unchanged batch size 64: confirm its parameter count, the save/reload round trip, and measure time and memory.

terminal.detail: EfficientNetB7 completed 1 epoch at batch size 64, the weight save/reload round trip and test evaluation on the A100-40GB.

runs.observed: Parameter count 64,204,093, equal to Table 1's 64.2 M. Reloaded weights reproduced the test metrics exactly. Fit time for 1 epoch (6 steps, including graph tracing): 55.2 s. Peak GPU memory 31.83 GB. Hypothesis supported: more GPU memory runs the unchanged batch size.

gates.reason: The dataset is not public and carries no license. The queue record says the authors granted permission to reproduce and supplied the archive, but does not state that project-cloud processing and storage are permitted. The dataset is absent from the shared Modal Volume 'datasets'.
evidence: Queue record, dataset entry: license empty, permission_to_reproduce 'yes', correspondence 'contacted_got_reply', on_modal empty.
modal volume ls datasets / on 2026-11-20 lists 31 directories, none for this dataset.
Four sampled images show one hand against a wall, no face.
gates.required_action: A study team member confirms that the authors' permission covers processing and storing the images in the repro-sign Modal workspace, and authorizes populating /datasets/<slug> on the shared Volume.
gates.resolution: A study team member confirmed that the images may be uploaded to and processed in the repro-sign Modal workspace, and authorized populating /datasets/ksl-fingerspelling-kenshimov-2021 on the shared Volume. The copy stays private to the workspace; no image is redistributed or committed.

gates.reason: The paper trains on 2,100 images, 50 per class, with a random 80/10/10 split. The supplied archive holds 14,249 images, 142 to 446 per class. Neither the paper nor the notebooks identify which 50 images per class were used, and the authors' split was unseeded, so the 210-image test set cannot be recovered.
evidence: Paper Sec. 5.1: 2,100 images, 42 classes, 50 each; random split into 1,680 / 210 / 210.
Read_data.ipynb saved output: 14,247 images loaded; train_test_split called without random_state.
Compare_nets.ipynb: 'Taking the first 50 names from os.listdir was a different subset every time the directory order changed' and 'The 2022 split was an unseeded train_test_split'.
Paper Fig. 9 and Fig. 10: the two test confusion matrices have different per-class counts, so LeNet and EfficientNet were tested on different random splits.
gates.required_action: Decide the subset rule and the split seed before any training run, and whether values obtained under them count as produced targets or as conditional evidence.
gates.resolution: Decided by a study team member before any training run. Subset: the first 50 files of each class folder in lexicographic file-name order. Split: random 80/10/10, not stratified, as in Read_data.ipynb, with seed 42 for both train_test_split calls and for weight initialization. Seeds 1, 2, 3 and 4 are run as supplementary evidence only and never replace the seed-42 values. Values obtained under these choices count as produced targets.

gates.reason: Table 1's Penalty column cannot be computed from the paper. Fig. 4 shows only a 12x12 excerpt of the 42x42 penalty matrix, and the stated formula S = -(1/N) * sum(A) yields values at or below zero, while Table 1 reports 3.017 to 3.130.
evidence: Paper Eq. (2) and Fig. 4, captioned 'Example of penalty matrix values': 12 of 42 classes shown.
Neither notebook defines a penalty matrix or a penalty score.

alternatives.description: Obtain the full 42x42 matrix and the exact scoring code from the authors through the study's data-access contact.
alternatives.paper_evidence: Fig. 4 is an excerpt; Eq. (2) does not reproduce the sign or scale of Table 1.
alternatives.decision_needed: Whether to request them; author contact is a human gate.

alternatives.description: Close the four Penalty targets as not produced, reason metric_ambiguous.
alternatives.paper_evidence: The matrix is unpublished beyond the excerpt.
alternatives.decision_needed: Whether to close them without contacting the authors.

gates.required_action: Choose between requesting the matrix from the authors and closing the four Penalty targets as not produced.
gates.resolution: A study team member chose alternative 'not-produced': the four Penalty targets are closed as not produced, reason metric_ambiguous, without contacting the authors for now.

noncompliance.description: populate-dataset-1 declared a 3,600 s wall-time ceiling, but its hung upload client was not stopped until about 66 hours after launch. The agent session was interrupted and nothing enforced the ceiling.
noncompliance.requirement: modal-data-compute.md, Full-run reliability: cancel runaway or clearly invalid work within the recorded stop ceiling; AGENTS.md: monitor remote jobs to a terminal state.
noncompliance.effect: None on data or results: the client transferred nothing, no Modal compute ran, and the Volume was unchanged.
noncompliance.resolution: Stopped on discovery. The retry runs the upload under a hard time limit.
